goal.en: Tell Finn you can't make Saturday, and set a new time.
goal.zh: 告訴芬恩你星期六不能去，並另約時間。

background: small corner café downtown in the afternoon, wooden tables and chairs, a long counter with an espresso machine, hanging plants, large windows, golden sunlight on the floor

intro.en: Wednesday afternoon. You and Finn planned a photo walk for Saturday.
intro.zh: 星期三下午。你和芬恩約好星期六去攝影散步。

intro.en: But this morning, your teacher moved your speaking test to Saturday. You stop by Finn's café to tell him.
intro.zh: 但今天早上，老師把你的口說考試改到星期六。你到芬恩上班的咖啡店找他。

lines.en: Kai! Ready for Saturday? I charged all my camera batteries!
lines.zh: 凱！星期六準備好了嗎？我把相機電池都充飽了！

choices.en: About that... sorry, something came up.
choices.zh: 說到這個……抱歉，我臨時有事。
choices.tip: Something came up. 是「臨時有事」最自然的說法，先道歉再說。

choices.en: Sorry, I have something temporary on Saturday.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我星期六臨時有事。

lines.en: Something temporary? Like a temporary tattoo?
lines.zh: 暫時的東西？像紋身貼紙那種？

story.en: Finn asks to see your temporary tattoo. You don't have one. The conversation goes nowhere.
story.zh: 芬恩想看你的紋身貼紙，但你根本沒有，對話卡住了。

fail.why: 「臨時有事」直翻成 something temporary，意思變成「暫時性的東西」。英文說 Something came up.，簡單又自然。

choices.en: I can't go on Saturday anymore. Too bad.
choices.zh: 我星期六不能去了。真可惜。

lines.en: Oh. Okay. Too bad, I guess.

story.en: Finn makes you a latte. There's a sad face drawn in the foam.
story.zh: 芬恩幫你做了一杯拿鐵，奶泡上畫了一張哭臉。

fail.why: 取消約定時只說 Too bad，聽起來好像這件事跟你無關。先道歉：Sorry, something came up.。

choices.en: My teacher moved my test to Saturday.
choices.zh: 老師把我的考試改到星期六了。
choices.tip: 說明原因時給一句簡短的理由，用過去式 moved 表示已經改了。

choices.en: My teacher change my speaking test to Saturday.
choices.zh: 老師把我的口說考試改到星期六。

lines.en: Your teacher changes tests every week? That sounds stressful.
lines.zh: 你們老師每週都改考試時間？聽起來壓力好大。

story.en: Finn feels so sorry for you that he gives you a free cookie every time you visit.
story.zh: 芬恩太同情你了，之後你每次來他都送你一片餅乾。

fail.why: 老師改時間是已經發生的事，要用過去式 moved 或 changed。少了 -ed，聽起來像老師每次都這樣。

choices.en: It's nothing special. Don't ask, OK?

story.en: Finn decides you're on a secret mission. He never asks you anything personal again.
story.zh: 芬恩認定你在執行祕密任務，從此再也不問你私事。

fail.why: 中文常用「有點事」「沒什麼」帶過，但英文取消約定時，對方會期待一句簡短的理由。說明原因，對方才知道你不是不想去。

lines.en: Ah, a test. That's important. So, what now?
lines.zh: 啊，考試，那很重要。那現在怎麼辦？

choices.en: Can we reschedule? I still really want to go.
choices.zh: 我們可以改時間嗎？我還是很想去。
choices.tip: Can we reschedule? 是改期的標準說法，加一句「還是很想去」讓對方安心。

choices.en: Can we change another day? I still want to go.
choices.zh: 我們可以改天嗎？我還是想去。

lines.en: Change another day? Like, turn Tuesday into Friday?
lines.zh: 改變另一天？像是把星期二變成星期五？

story.en: Finn jokes that you have the power to change the days of the week. He asks you to make every day Saturday.
story.zh: 芬恩開玩笑說你有改變星期幾的超能力，拜託你把每天都變成星期六。

fail.why: 「改天」直翻成 change another day 不通。改時間的動詞是 reschedule：Can we reschedule?，也可以說 Can we do it another day?。

choices.en: Now? I'm going back to school after this.
choices.zh: 現在？我等一下要回學校。

lines.en: Ha, no, I meant our photo walk! Not right now.
lines.zh: 哈，不是啦，我是問攝影散步怎麼辦！不是問你現在。

story.en: Finn waves goodbye as you leave. You realize on the bus that you never set a new date.
story.zh: 芬恩跟你揮手道別。坐上公車你才發現，根本沒約新的時間。

fail.why: So, what now? 在這裡是「那接下來怎麼辦」，問的是計畫，不是你等一下要去哪。

lines.en: Of course we can. When are you free this week?
lines.zh: 當然可以。你這週什麼時候有空？

choices.en: Would Friday work? I'm free after three.
choices.zh: 星期五可以嗎？我三點以後有空。
choices.tip: Would ... work? 是提出時間的禮貌問法，讓對方有選擇的空間。

choices.en: Is Friday OK? I free after three.
choices.zh: 星期五可以嗎？我三點以後有空。

lines.en: You... free after three? Free what?
lines.zh: 你……三點以後免費？什麼免費？

story.en: Finn thinks you're giving something away after three. He shows up on Friday with a big empty bag.
story.zh: 芬恩以為你三點後要送東西，星期五帶著一個大空袋子出現。

fail.why: free 是形容詞，前面要有 be 動詞：I'm free after three.。少了 am，free 聽起來像「免費」。

choices.en: Friday. You must be free on Friday.
choices.zh: 星期五。你星期五一定要有空。

story.en: Finn salutes you every time you walk into the café now.
story.zh: 現在你每次走進咖啡店，芬恩都會向你敬禮。

fail.why: You must... 聽起來像命令。改期是你提出的，要用問句讓對方決定：Would Friday work?

lines.en: Friday works! The sunset light will be perfect for photos.
lines.zh: 星期五可以！那時候的夕陽光線最適合拍照。

lines.en: Finn writes "Friday, 3:30" on a coffee cup and hands it to you.
lines.zh: 芬恩在咖啡杯上寫下「星期五 3:30」，遞給了你。

story.en: On Friday, you take your best photos ever in the golden light. On Saturday, you do great on your speaking test.
story.zh: 星期五，你在金色的光線下拍出最滿意的照片；星期六，你的口說考試也考得很好。

notes.explain: 臨時無法赴約時最自然的說法。不要直翻成 something temporary。說完最好再補一句簡短理由。

example.en: Sorry, something came up at work.

notes.explain: reschedule 是「重新安排時間」，改約、改會議都能用。「改天」不能說 change another day。

example.en: Can we reschedule our meeting to Monday?
example.zh: 我們的會議可以改到星期一嗎？

notes.explain: 提出時間時用問句，讓對方有選擇的空間，比 You must... 有禮貌。也可以說 Does Friday work for you?。
free 是形容詞，前面一定要有 be 動詞：I'm free.。少了 am，聽起來像「免費」。
中文常用「有點事」帶過，但英文取消約定時，給一句簡短理由能讓對方知道你不是不想去。不用講太細，一句就夠。

example.en: Sorry, I have to work late that day.
